modelOverview: Introduced in 2020, the RM 72-01 Lifestyle Flyback Chronograph was the first chronograph movement Richard Mille developed entirely in-house. Its Calibre CRMC1 uses a patented double-oscillating-pinion flyback architecture that isolates the chronograph from the timekeeping train, and the model brought the tonneau case down to a slimmer, dressier 11.68mm profile than the RM 011 family it complements.

RM 72-01.movement: Automatic · Richard Mille Calibre CRMC1 · skeletonised, bidirectional winding with platinum rotor · flyback chronograph · 28,800vph · ~50h power reserve
RM 72-01.materials: Available in grade 5 titanium, 18k 5N red gold, and white ATZ or black TZP ceramic with a red gold caseband
RM 72-01.dial: Skeletonised dial with three colour-coded chronograph counters at 1, 4 and 9 o'clock, small seconds, semi-instantaneous date at 7 o'clock and a function indicator
RM 72-01.description: The RM 72-01 Lifestyle Flyback Chronograph carries Richard Mille's first in-house chronograph, the Calibre CRMC1, whose patented double-oscillating-pinion system spreads torque across the counters so the base movement runs undisturbed when the chronograph is engaged. The slimmer tonneau case and asymmetric counter layout give it a more formal character than the brand's sport chronographs, in titanium, red gold or ceramic and red gold. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Lifestyle Flyback Chronograph: The RM 72-01 as launched in 2020 — 11.68mm tonneau case, skeletonised Calibre CRMC1 automatic flyback chronograph with platinum rotor and three colour-accented counters, offered in titanium, red gold and ceramic executions.
